item.title: Health costs are fueling voter stress - and Democratic campaigns
item.description: ATLANTA (AP) — President Donald Trump ’s second term has presented an array of opportunities for political opponents, from immigration crackdowns and lingering inflation to attacks on independent institutions and friction with overseas allies.

item.title: Grant scores 23 points to help Trail Blazers rout Grizzlies, 135-115
item.description: PORTLAND (AP) — Jerami Grant had 23 points and the Portland Trail Blazers snapped a six-game losing streak, beating the Memphis Grizzlies 135-115 on Friday night to open a two-game set. The teams will meet again Saturday night in Portland.

item.title: Scotty Pippen Jr. makes season debut for the Grizzlies after toe surgery
item.description: PORTLAND Ore. (AP) — Guard Scotty Pippen Jr. made his season debut for the Memphis Grizzlies on Friday night after undergoing surgery on his left big toe in October.

item.title: Henderson makes season debut for Portland after hamstring injury
item.description: PORTLAND, Ore. (AP) — Scoot Henderson made his season debut for the Portland Trail Blazers on Friday night after recovering from a torn left hamstring. Henderson was injured during an offseason workout in September.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard's 31 points lift Clippers over Kings, handing Sacramento 11th straight loss
item.description: SACRAMENTO, Calif. (AP) — Kawhi Leonard scored 31 points, grabbed nine rebounds and had seven assists to lead the Los Angeles Clippers to a 114-111 victory over Sacramento on Friday night, sending the Kings to their 11th straight loss.

item.title: Alberta hospital support staff ratify collective agreement with province: union
item.description: EDMONTON — The union representing thousands of front-line hospital workers in Alberta says its new collective agreement with the province has been ratified.

item.title: Pistons rout Knicks 118-80, end New York's 8-game winning streak
item.description: DETROIT (AP) — Daniss Jenkins scored 18 points in his last game as a two-way player and the Detroit Pistons routed New York 118-80 on Friday night to end the Knicks’ winning streak at eight games.
